ci: remove registry-url from setup-node in release workflows (#1330)

### Summary
Removing `registry-url` from `actions/setup-node` prevents it from
generating an unnecessary `.npmrc` containing `${NODE_AUTH_TOKEN}`,
which causes Yarn Classic 1.x to fail during dependency installation
when `NODE_AUTH_TOKEN` is not set. Trusted publishing (OIDC) uses
environment variables provided by GitHub Actions and does not need
`registry-url` configured in
